brand.legal_group: Part of Global Catering · Bali, Indonesia
brand.origin_story: Founded by Adriano after arriving in Bali in 2018; built to connect world-class villas with restaurant-level private dining and local sourcing.

primary.name: Private Fine Dining
primary.description: 24 set menus, multi-course tasting experiences, Chef's Table, romantic dinners in private Bali villas.

primary.name: Catering
primary.description: BBQ, buffet, plated set menus, drop-off, Babi Guling, grazing tables, floating breakfast, villa and corporate catering.

primary.name: Events
primary.description: End-to-end villa events: weddings, birthdays, anniversaries, corporate events, wellness retreats, baby showers, villa parties.

secondary.name: Staffing & Placement
secondary.description: Long-term private chef placement, live-in villa chefs, villa and household staff.

secondary.name: VIP Transport
secondary.description: Luxury cars, minibuses, buses, yacht charters, landing boats to Nusa Penida/Lembongan.

secondary.name: Bar Services for Venues
secondary.description: B2B bar consulting, staffing, management and flagship performance programmes for hotels, villas, beach clubs, restaurants and events.

secondary.name: Complete Villa Experience / Villa Event Packages
secondary.description: All-inclusive bundles: airport transfers, villa preparation, daily private chef, events, bar service, staffing, concierge and cleanup/handback.

Full liability insurance for events up to 200 guests

claims_not_to_misrepresent: Do not invent a specific Michelin-starred restaurant where Adriano trained; the site itself uses inconsistent phrasing (Milan vs. Modena).
Do not inflate or invent awards; 'Best Partner 2026' appears only as image alt text with no named awarding body.
Do not show Adriano available for every booking; he is limited to Fri/Sat Chef's Table and select tasting menus.
Do not show branded vehicles, uniforms, or logos beyond what the current site already depicts.
Do not invent historical dates, partnership names, or specific villa properties.
Avoid placing website text, prices, or logos inside generated photographs.
Keep published metrics aligned: 560+ events, 12,000+ guests, 500+ villa bookings, 50+ staff, 8+ years in Bali.

avoid: Text, logos, prices, or awards in photographs
